observations.interaction: Native shell chrome can own panel/dock input focus and delegate content/customization regions to WebKitGTK web views.
observations.layering: Layer-shell anchoring can keep dock and panel surfaces out of normal application toplevel management when compositor support is present.
observations.deployment: Product source belongs under chrome/; deploy/ should package built chrome artifacts only after the source architecture is chosen.
observations.inspection: Layer-shell chrome still requires compositor capture/readback evidence for user-visible claims; DOM-level checks are not sufficient.

decision.reason: Keep as an inspectable spike until den-k8 live evidence proves native layer-shell chrome is more reliable than webview-hosted shell chrome for dock/panel claims.
